draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Ratnagiri! This Konkan port on the Arabian Sea is the birthplace of Lokmanya Tilak. It's also where the British exiled Thibaw, the last king of Burma, to a brick mansion you can still visit.
draft.hungryLine: Ratnagiri is nicknamed the Mango City for its Hapus, the Alphonso mango, so if they're in season, eat as many as you can.

moodReplies.show-me-around: King Thibaw Palace is a 12 minute walk from here, and Ratnadurga Fort, with the sea on three sides, makes a great next stop.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head to Bhatyachi Khadi, where the river meets the sea and casuarina trees line the shore.
moodReplies.surprise-me: King Thibaw arrived here in exile with his consort Supayalat and their two infant daughters in the late 19th century.

spots.name: King Thibaw Palace
spots.detail: 12 min walk · Pagoda-style palace where the last Burmese king was held by the British

status.text: Part of it is now a polytechnic

spots.name: Ratnadurga Fort
spots.detail: Nearby · A sea fort with a temple of Goddess Bhagwati inside

spots.name: Bhagvati Bundar
spots.detail: Nearby · An old harbour that's now a white sand beach

tips.title: Visit Tilak's birthplace.
tips.body: The Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak Smarak keeps his home and a monument to the man who set off the Swadeshi Movement.

tips.title: Pick your sand colour.
tips.body: Bhagvati Bundar has white sand, while Mandvi Bundar is the one to go to for black sand.

story.title: A fort in the sea
story.body: Ratnadurga Fort was built with the sea on three sides, with a temple of Goddess Bhagwati inside. Nearby, Bhagvati Bundar was once a working harbour.

story.title: A freedom fighter's home
story.body: Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak was born in Ratnagiri. He went on to set off the Swadeshi Movement and lead the fight against the British Raj.

story.title: A king in exile
story.body: The British exiled Thibaw, the last king of Burma, to a two-storey brick mansion here, along with his consort Supayalat and their two daughters. Today it's known as Thibaw Palace.

story.title: The Mango City
story.body: Ratnagiri is famous for its Hapus or Alphonso mangoes. Savarkar's Patit Pawan Mandir, which he built for the patit class of people, still stands in town.
